command.abortCommit: Generate Commit Message with SenseAudio - Stop
config.title: SenseAudio Copilot
config.commitLanguage.desc: Language for generated Git commit messages. When set to "auto", the language is detected from recent commit history. Defaults to English if no history exists.
config.commitLanguage.auto.desc: Auto-detect language from recent commit history (defaults to English)
config.commitModel.desc: Model ID used for commit message generation.
config.commitMessagePrompt.desc: Custom system prompt for commit message generation.
config.requestTimeout.desc: Maximum time (in milliseconds) for a single request. Default: 600000 (10 minutes). Increase if you encounter timeout errors with long responses.
config.recentCommitsCount.desc: Number of recent commits to analyze for style reference when generating commit messages. Set to 0 to disable. Default: 10.
config.commitIncludeCommitDiff.desc: When enabled, include the actual code changes (diff) of recent commits in the style reference, helping the model generate messages that better match the project's commit style. Default: false.
config.commitAttachContextFiles.desc: When enabled, attach the content of AGENTS.md and README.md from the repository root as additional context for commit message generation, helping the model better understand the project. Default: true.
config.modelPreset.desc: Current model preset ID. Set to 'custom' to use manual values from 'senseaudio.temperature' and 'senseaudio.top_p'.
config.temperature.desc: Model temperature (0.0 - 2.0). Paired with 'senseaudio.top_p'. Only used when 'senseaudio.modelPreset' is set to 'custom'.
config.top_p.desc: Model top_p (0.0 - 1.0). Paired with 'senseaudio.temperature'. Only used when 'senseaudio.modelPreset' is set to 'custom'.
config.enableAutoModelDiscovery.desc: Enable automatic model discovery. When enabled, the extension fetches the model list from the API and filters the model picker to show only models available on the server. Models not in the API list are hidden. New models on the server that are not in the built-in list are automatically added using metadata from models.dev — models that support reasoning get a thinking toggle (switchable), others keep thinking always on. Disable to see all built-in models regardless of API availability.
config.syncModelsOnStartup.desc: Check for new SenseAudio models on startup, at most once per day. Sync results are reported as a single line in the "SenseAudio" Output channel. Default: true.
config.maxInputTokensRatio.desc: Ratio of the real context window declared as maxInputTokens for each model (0.1 - 1.0, default 1.0). VS Code's agent auto-compaction triggers at ~90% of the declared maxInputTokens. **Recommended: 0.8** — this makes compaction fire at ~72% of the real window, preventing context overflow for BYOK models with very large windows (e.g. 1M tokens) where full declaration (1.0) would never trigger compaction. Does not affect the context_length sent in API requests, which always uses the real value.
config.modelPresets.desc: Model presets selectable via the 'senseaudio.modelPreset' setting. Each preset includes temperature and top_p. You can customize the presets.
config.modelPreset.id.desc: Preset identifier (must match the value in modelPreset setting).
config.visionProxyModel.desc: Vision model used by the ask_image tool to answer questions about attached images when the selected model does not support vision. Set this to a vision-capable model ID (e.g. qwen3.6-35b-a3b, qwen3.8-27b, deepseek-v4.1-flash, glm-5.3-flash). Default: qwen3.6-35b-a3b.
config.visionProxyThinking.desc: Enable thinking/reasoning in the vision proxy model when answering image queries.
config.enableThirdPartyTokenIndicator.de: Enable the Advanced Token indicator in the status bar. The native Copilot token indicator always shows. When this is enabled, the extension also shows an advanced token counter in the VS Code status bar. The plan-usage display is independent of this setting. Default: false.
config.apiMode.desc: API protocol used for chat requests. The platform supports OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, and Responses API formats. Default: auto (follows each model's default format; in auto mode, models reporting supports_responses=true use the Responses protocol only when enableResponsesApi is on, otherwise they fall back to OpenAI).
config.apiMode.enum.auto.desc: Auto — use each model's default API format. Models that support the Responses API (supports_responses=true) use it only when the enableResponsesApi setting is enabled; otherwise they use the OpenAI-compatible format.
config.apiMode.enum.anthropic.desc: Anthropic — use the Anthropic format (POST /v1/messages). Note: some models have compatibility issues with the Anthropic protocol (e.g. DeepSeek forced thinking + temperature returns 400); the OpenAI-compatible format is recommended.
config.apiMode.enum.responses.desc: Responses — use the OpenAI Responses API format (POST /v1/responses). Only models with supports_responses=true support this protocol.
config.enableResponsesApi.desc: Use the Responses API protocol for models that support it (supports_responses=true, e.g. glm-5.3-flash, deepseek-v4-flash-0731) when apiMode is set to auto. **Disabled by default** — the SenseAudio Responses endpoint is still evolving (inconsistent stream event types across models, unstable tool calling, and non-standard multi-round tool backfill), so models default to the OpenAI-compatible format which is more mature. Enable this only if you want to try the Responses protocol.
config.enableAnthropicApi.desc: Use the Anthropic Messages protocol in auto mode for models detected as supports_anthropic=true at startup (from /v1/models — dynamic, no hardcoded model IDs). **Disabled by default** — the Anthropic endpoint has compatibility issues with some models (e.g. DeepSeek forced thinking + temperature returns 400), so the more mature OpenAI-compatible format is recommended. In auto mode, priority: Responses (if enabled) > Anthropic > OpenAI.
config.apiKeyMode.desc: API Key usage mode: sticky (stick to one key, switch only when it becomes unavailable — best prefix-cache hit rate), rotation (round-robin across all keys, skipping unavailable ones) or single (only use the current key).
config.apiKeyMode.enum.sticky.desc: Stick to one API key by default (highest prefix-cache hit rate). Switch to the next available key only when the current one becomes unavailable (insufficient balance / rate-limited / invalid, etc.) and keep using it.
config.apiKeyMode.enum.rotation.desc: Round-robin across all API keys, automatically skipping unavailable ones.
config.apiKeyMode.enum.single.desc: Only use the currently selected API key.
config.singleKeyFallback.desc: Behavior when the current key fails in single mode: switch (default; automatically switch to the next available key and make it the current one ONLY when the current key is out of balance — 402 or balance pre-check — with a notification; other rotation errors such as 401/429/503 do not switch) or error (always fail without switching).
config.singleKeyFallback.enum.error.desc: Report an error without switching to another key.
config.singleKeyFallback.enum.switch.des: Switch to the next available key and make it the current one only when the current key is out of balance (402 / balance pre-check), with a bottom-right notification. Other rotation errors (401/429/503) do not switch.
config.apiKeyRotationStatusCodes.desc: HTTP status codes that trigger automatic API key rotation (matched against [code] or status code in error messages). Default: [401, 402, 429, 503] — invalid key, insufficient balance, rate limit, and server busy all rotate to the next key.
config.apiKeyRotationErrorPatterns.desc: Error message text patterns that trigger automatic API key rotation (matched case-insensitively).
config.transientRetryStatusCodes.desc: HTTP status codes treated as transient platform errors (busy / rate-limited / internal error) that trigger whole-round auto-retry. When every key fails with one of these, the rotation loop backs off and retries automatically (see transientRetryTimes). Codes that ALSO appear in apiKeyRotationStatusCodes (e.g. 429/503) mark the key as cooling and rotate; codes that do NOT (e.g. 500 Internal Server Error) leave the key untouched and simply retry the same key — a 500 is a platform problem, not a key problem. Default: [429, 500, 503].
config.apiKeyExhaustedCooldownMin.desc: Cooldown (minutes) for transiently exhausted keys (e.g. rate-limited with 429) before they can be reused. 0 = immediately reusable.
config.transientRetryTimes.desc: How many times to automatically retry the whole key-rotation round when every key fails with a transient error (429 rate limit / 500 internal error / 503 server busy). Waits with exponential backoff (2s/4s/8s) between rounds and clears the transient cooldown before retrying. 0 = disable auto-retry.
config.cloudSyncAutoPull.desc: Automatically pull key/cookie/label triples from the cloud Gist on startup when the cloud copy is newer than the last sync. Uses VS Code's built-in GitHub sign-in; silently skips when not signed in.
config.cloudSyncAutoPush.desc: Automatically push local key changes to the cloud Gist after key-management operations. Debounced and silent on failure. Safe only when keys are managed on a single machine; do not use with different keys across multiple machines.
config.showUsageInStatusBar.desc: Show the plan usage (5-hour window percentage) in the status bar main text. When disabled, the status bar shows token counts instead. Token counts always remain in the tooltip.
config.showUsageInTooltip.desc: Show the plan usage section (5-hour / weekly / monthly windows, reset countdown and balance) in the status bar tooltip.
config.usageRefreshInterval.desc: Background plan-usage refresh interval in minutes (1-60). The status bar and tooltip are re-rendered after each refresh.
config.minBalanceCny.desc: Balance threshold (CNY). Total available balance (cash + vouchers) at or below this value is flagged with an error icon in the API key manager.
config.balanceCheckIntervalSec.desc: Cache TTL (seconds) for the account info / plan usage query. 0 = always re-fetch.
config.delay.desc: Minimum delay (ms) between consecutive API requests. 0 = no delay. Useful for avoiding rate limits.
config.readFileLines.desc: When the model calls the read_file tool without an explicit range, automatically expand the range to at least this many lines. 0 = disabled.
config.visionMaxRounds.desc: Maximum number of ask_image vision-proxy rounds per request (1-20). Each round lets the model ask the vision model another question about the attached image(s).
config.retry.enabled.desc: Enable the HTTP-layer retry (retry the same request with backoff). This is separate from the whole-round retry (transientRetryTimes), which re-runs the key-rotation loop and can switch keys.
config.retry.maxAttempts.desc: HTTP-layer retry attempts per request (1-10). Keep this small — it multiplies with transientRetryTimes for status codes present in both lists.
config.retry.intervalMs.desc: Base delay (ms) before the first HTTP-layer retry. Doubles on each subsequent attempt (exponential backoff, capped at 60s).
config.retry.statusCodes.desc: Additional HTTP status codes to retry at the HTTP layer. Gateway errors (502/504) and network errors are always retried; platform errors (429/500/503) are handled by the whole-round retry instead.
